section_entries.mathematical_role: Extends generating functions, cumulants, Gaussian limits, variances, and leading moment coefficients across circular symmetry classes.

neighboring_unit_entries.title: COE and CSE change the variance scale and constant term
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: Computes the next variance asymptotics separately for symplectic and orthogonal ensembles, including the even/odd matrix-size issue, while retaining equality of real and imaginary variances.

neighboring_unit_entries.title: COE leading coefficients shift the moment subsequence and pole/zero pattern
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: Provides the orthogonal analogue, with different normalization, rational moment subsequence, and analytic pole/zero structure for modulus and phase generators.

related_synthesis_entries.claim: Orthogonal, unitary, and symplectic models share logarithmic variance plus bounded higher cumulants, yet differ in variance constants, admissible rational moment subsequences, and pole/zero patterns.
related_synthesis_entries.limit: Applying a non-CUE class to an L-function requires an independently justified family-symmetry assignment, and exact special-function formulas are extraction-sensitive.
related_synthesis_entries.title: Symmetry class changes constants without changing the Gaussian mechanism
